# Diablo II material by other authors

Preserved from <http://paul.siramy.free.fr/> alongside Paul Siramy's own
documentation, and kept in a separate directory because it is not his writing.

## `_divers/old_tools/`

A saved copy of forum threads, titled by whoever saved it *"Some backup of old
Tools Forum"* — 20 files, including the browser's saved-page assets. The posts
are by various members of the Diablo II modding community, written to a forum
that no longer exists at the address they were saved from.

The individual authors are not identified here because the saved pages do not
reliably identify them, and guessing would be worse than saying so. Whoever
wrote a given post owns it.

## Why keep it

The same reason as the rest of this directory: Diablo II modding knowledge from
the early 2000s is scattered across personal pages and dead forums, and it
disappears quietly. A copy costs 80 KB.

## Terms

Preserved as-is, with no claim to it, and separated from Paul's work so that
nothing here is mistaken for his. If you wrote any of this and would prefer it
removed or credited differently, open an issue at
<https://github.com/bethington/d2-ds1-edit> and it will be done.

See [../README.md](../README.md) for how the copy was taken and
[../MANIFEST.tsv](../MANIFEST.tsv) for the checksum of every file.
